meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取谷歌地图商家信息,整理成可直接联系的客户线索清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在为本地生意找潜在客户,需要一份能直接联系的商家名单。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Maps listings into a lead list of local businesses and contacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're hunting local prospects and need a contactable business list.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Docker 在本机运行 Google Maps 抓取工具，把“柏林的牙医”这类搜索转成多条查询，抓取商家名称、类别、评分、评论数、电话、网站等，先给前 20 行预览，再按你的要求保存、分析或筛选。
howto.when: 当你说“找柏林的牙医”、“抓取 Google Maps”，或想获取本地商家线索与评论时触发；需要本机已安装并运行 Docker。

say.text: 帮我找柏林的牙医，结果给我 CSV
say.note: 默认浅度抓取，每条约 20 条

say.text: 再抓深一点，覆盖整个柏林
say.note: 会跑网格搜索，耗时较长

say.text: 按评分排序，只要 4.5 分以上的
say.note: 在结果表上筛选后输出

howto.what_en: Claude runs the open-source Google Maps scraper in Docker locally: it turns a request like "dentists in Berlin" into queries, collects names, ratings, review counts, phone and website, previews the top 20 rows, then saves, analyzes or filters.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find businesses, extract leads or get reviews from Google Maps (e.g. "find dentists in Berlin"). Requires Docker installed and running.

say_en.text: Find dentists in Berlin and give me the results as CSV
say_en.note: Default shallow depth, ~20 results per query

say_en.text: Go deeper and cover all of Berlin
say_en.note: Runs a grid search; can take 30+ minutes

say_en.text: Sort by rating, keep only 4.5 and above
